title: Hedgehog’s Favorite
author: Isaac Banner
problems: Row 4 "circle right 3 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 9 "circle left 3 places single-file, larks turn back to face partners · turn-back" can't start from where the dancers are: No larks here to turn back.
choices: Pass through goes by right shoulders.
A pass through from a ring goes along the set, to the dancer on your own side.
A meltdown swing starts with 4 beats of right-shoulder round, then swings.
